name: Formian Traits — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Formian Traits from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Formian Warrior, Elite" but are not part of the Formian Traits entry, which is unchanged.

hp 42 (4d10+1d10+10)
Fort +5, Ref +7, Will +5
Resist sonic 10

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee sting +7 (1d4+2 P plus poison), 2 claws +7 (1d4+2 B&S plus grab)
Ranged laser rifle +8 touch (2d6 fire, 150-ft. range incr., automatic) or javelin +8 (1d6+2 P plus poison, 30-ft. range incr.)
Special Attacks deadly grasp, poison

STATISTICS

Str 14 (+2), Dex 17 (+3), Con 15 (+2), Int 13 (+1), Wis 12 (+1), Cha 12 (+1)
Base Atk +5; CMB +7 (+11 to grapple); CMD 20 (21 vs. overrun, 25 vs. trip)
Feats Combat Reflexes, Nimble Moves (B), Point-Blank Shot, Step Up
Skills Acrobatics +11 (+15 to jump), Climb +9, Intimidate +9, Perception +9 (+13 with hive mind), Stealth +10, Survival +7
Languages Common; telepathy 60 ft.
SQ coordinate, fighter training, fighting style (rover), fighting style techniques (survivalist), formian traits

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Coordinate (Su)

Formian Traits (Ex or Su)

Formians are a spacefaring race of insect-like creatures who have spread out from their original, forested homeworld to aggressively colonize other worlds. Unless otherwise noted in a creature’s entry, a formian possesses the following traits. (A formian surveyor does not gain these traits.)

Darkvision 60 feet and blindsense 30 feet.
Hive Mind (Ex)

Telepathy 60 ft.

ECOLOGY

Environment any land or underground
Organization solitary, pair, patrol (3–12), or band (5–8 plus 3–15 formian workers)
Treasure standard (freebooter armor, laser rifle [10 charges], 6 javelins, other treasure)

The formians are a species of antlike insectoids who have aggressively colonized planets and planar realms throughout the multiverse. They often travel in primitive “seedpod” ships that are little more than hollowed-out asteroids protected by magic and sent hurtling through space toward the next planet, with the queen, several guards, and hundreds of eggs held in stasis inside.

Although not as scientifically advanced as some species, they strive to adapt to the planets they invade, and will adopt new technologies from their neighbors if they get the chance. Formians are not evil, but they are tough negotiators and opportunistic expansionists. They use whatever means they can to protect themselves and their newly captured lands.

Sometimes called “ant centaurs,” a formian’s segmented body is bent backward at the waist, with four lower limbs used as legs and while the two upper ones serve as arms.

Formian society is highly regimented. A formian’s role in this society is set according to their caste, their body shaped chemically by their pre-determined caste. Although they have free will, they are bonded by telepathic links and share a groupthink mentality that mimics a hivemind.

Among those who belong to the warrior caste, the cleverest are selected for elite training, gaining class levels in addition to their species Hit Dice.
